provenance.date_convention: fixed synthetic date for neutral ordering; not article publication dates

evidence_attainability.metric_limit: each complete annotation must fit one page and matching original source span; cross-page union is not scored

storage_before_close.boundary: Allocated content lengths of regular files, excluding symlinked caches; not filesystem allocated blocks. State can contain native source-page Markdown and logs in addition to database files.

metadata.setup_policy: Copy the same baseline-ingested archive; Q2 builds its own measured index. Native stages separately measure fresh source ingestion.
metadata.comparison_scope: Supplied-page Book ranker including native hierarchy metadata and native context assembly.
metadata.latency_scope: In-process Python recall and context assembly; no bridge IPC.

storage_after_close.boundary: Allocated content lengths of regular files, excluding symlinked caches; not filesystem allocated blocks. State can contain native source-page Markdown and logs in addition to database files.

repeat_hit_changes_boundary: Changes in mapped supplied-page ID lists, including None positions. Original native result IDs are retained as SHA256 values; metadata identity changes within an unchanged None slot are not counted here.
quality_boundary: First response only, six offline whole-block projections. Every native top-five slot, including ai-memory metadata None, and all three search repetitions remain recorded. No extra diagnostic or replacement query.
search_plus_all_reads_boundary: Per-query first-pass adapter search roundtrip plus all declared read roundtrips, before percentiles. Excludes evaluator token counting and offline common packing.

native_costs.read_policy: First repetition: read every mapped native top-five page in full. Metadata None slots earn no evidence, are not read, and are not replaced. Other engines need no extra native page read.

resources.boundary: Linux worker plus live descendant RSS sampled every 20ms; shared mappings can be counted more than once. Peaks are observed lower bounds, not unique physical memory. Worker ru_maxrss includes the Python evaluator and loaded corpus. The sampler runs during all engine phases.
